title: Best Framer Alternatives: Ship the Site, Not the Canvas
summary: Six Framer alternatives compared on seat costs, AI credits and export rights. Every price read off the vendor's own page and dated, after the June repricing.
body_markdown: The self-hosting answer here is self-hosted WordPress: GPLv2 software on your own server with your own MySQL database, which makes lock-in impossible by construction. The trade is that you become the operations team — Patchstack recorded 11,334 new WordPress ecosystem vulnerabilities in 2025, 91% of them in plugins. Blink is not open source, but the exit is written into the terms: you "retain full ownership" of the code with the right to sell or open-source it, there is a code download from Starter and two-way GitHub sync, and the export docs supply a Dockerfile template naming Vercel, Netlify, Railway, Render and custom Docker. Two caveats: secrets must be re-created, and database data is handled separately from code.
